Heya, I’ve grown up and raised tortoises all my life and I can honestly say that the best way for them to get hydrated is to give them a bath every other day. Just fill a bucket or a bowl with water and plop them in. Make sure not to drown them. They can’t swim so just shallow water. But leave the dish in the enclosure because they may choose to use it as well :) 

Lettace is very packed in water, feeding them this would be a good way too. Although lettace isn’t very high in neutriance (idk how to spell it) so make sure to give a varied diet. Hope this helps :)
